<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/deleteMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");
                            $('#displyMessage').dialog("open");
                            window.location = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/listMatches.do?clubId=13647';
                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/lockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/unLockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {

                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr("href", "javascript:lockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#unLockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Lock');
                                //$(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    // $("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

    });

    function deleteMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#deleteMessage").html(name);
        $("#deleteId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog("open");
    }

    function lockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#lockMessage").html(name);
        $("#lockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog("open");
    }

    function unLockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#unLockMessage").html(name);
        $("#unLockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog("open");
    }

    function loadView(view) {
        //$('#loading').dialog('open');
        var currentURL = window.location.href;
        var queryString = currentURL.substring(currentURL.indexOf('?'));
        window.location.href = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/' + view + '.do' + queryString;

    }

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function() {
            $('[data-toggle="popover"]').popover();
        });

        //Load Video Data.
        var listOfVideo = [];

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                                }
                            } else {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);
                                const Player = document.getElementById("CCVideoPlayer");
                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                Player.onended = function () {
                                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {

                    $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

<script>

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/deleteMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");
                            $('#displyMessage').dialog("open");
                            window.location = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/listMatches.do?clubId=13647';
                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/lockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/unLockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {

                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr("href", "javascript:lockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#unLockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Lock');
                                //$(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    // $("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

    });

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function() {
            $('[data-toggle="popover"]').popover();
        });

        //Load Video Data.
        var listOfVideo = [];

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                                }
                            } else {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);
                                const Player = document.getElementById("CCVideoPlayer");
                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                Player.onended = function () {
                                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {
                                        Player.src = nextsrc[elm];
                                        elm++;
                                        Player.play();
                                    } else {
                                        elm = 0; // Reset playlist
                                    }
                                };

                                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
                                setTimeout(() => Player.play(), 500);

                                runningVideo = 0;
                                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo).css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
                            }
                        });
                    } else {
                        videoLinkElement.hide();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        $(window).resize(function () {
            $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "position", "center"); //places the dialog box at the center
            $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog({
                width: $(window).width() > 600 ? $(window).width() - ($(window).width() * 35 / 100) : 'auto',
            });
        });
        let nextsrc = [];
        let runningVideo = 0;
        let ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS;
        let changeClicked = false;

        function pushBallDataToJQS(videoParam, videoSrcIdx) {
            const videoLink = videoParam.ballVideoLink;
            nextsrc.push(videoLink);

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

        var listOfVideo = [];

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/deleteMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");
                            $('#displyMessage').dialog("open");
                            window.location = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/listMatches.do?clubId=13647';
                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/lockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/unLockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function() {
            $('[data-toggle="popover"]').popover();
        });

        //Load Video Data.
        var listOfVideo = [];

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                                }
                            } else {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);
                                const Player = document.getElementById("CCVideoPlayer");
                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                Player.onended = function () {
                                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {
                                        Player.src = nextsrc[elm];
                                        elm++;
                                        Player.play();
                                    } else {
                                        elm = 0; // Reset playlist
                                    }
                                };

                                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
                                setTimeout(() => Player.play(), 500);

                                runningVideo = 0;
                                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo).css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
                            }
                        });
                    } else {
                        videoLinkElement.hide();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        $(window).resize(function () {
            $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "position", "center"); //places the dialog box at the center
            $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog({
                width: $(window).width() > 600 ? $(window).width() - ($(window).width() * 35 / 100) : 'auto',
            });
        });
        let nextsrc = [];
        let runningVideo = 0;
        let ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS;
        let changeClicked = false;

        function pushBallDataToJQS(videoParam, videoSrcIdx) {
            const videoLink = videoParam.ballVideoLink;
            nextsrc.push(videoLink);
            ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS.append(
                "<span class='circle-ball' style='cursor: pointer;' id='ball_idx_" + videoSrcIdx +
                "' onclick='changeTheVideo(" + videoSrcIdx + ")'>" + videoParam.runsDisplay + "</span>");
        }

        function playInHtml5Video(playerId, playerType, playerName) {
            nextsrc = [];
            if (!listOfVideo) {
                return false;
            }
            const videoLink = listOfVideo[0].ballVideoLink;
            if (videoLink.includes('youtube')) {
                ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS = $("#ballCirclesInYoutube");
            } else {
                ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS = $("#ballCirclesInVideoPlayer");
            }
            playerId = parseInt(playerId);
            ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS.empty();
            let videoSrcIdx = 0;

            if (playerType === 'bt') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    const batsmen = listOfVideo[i].batsman;
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'bwl') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].bowler === playerId) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'out') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay === 'W') {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'four') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay == 4) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'six') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay == 6) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'blwicket') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].bowler === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay === 'W') {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

    $(document).ready(function () {

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,

            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/deleteMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");

                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/lockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/unLockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {

                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr("href", "javascript:lockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#unLockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Lock');
                                //$(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    // $("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

    });

    function deleteMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#deleteMessage").html(name);
        $("#deleteId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog("open");
    }

    function lockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#lockMessage").html(name);
        $("#lockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog("open");
    }

    function unLockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#unLockMessage").html(name);
        $("#unLockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog("open");
    }

    function loadView(view) {
        //$('#loading').dialog('open');
        var currentURL = window.location.href;
        var queryString = currentURL.substring(currentURL.indexOf('?'));
        window.location.href = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/' + view + '.do' + queryString;

    }

        }
    });

function convertToEmbedLink(originalLink) {
    let videoId = "";
    if (originalLink.includes("youtube.com/watch?v=")) {
        videoId = originalLink.split("v=")[1].split("&")[0]; // Extract ID from `watch?v=`
    } else if (originalLink.includes("youtu.be/")) {
        videoId = originalLink.split("youtu.be/")[1].split("?")[0]; // Extract ID from shortened link
    } else {
        return "Invalid YouTube URL";
    }
    return "https://www.youtube.com/embed/" + videoId;
}

function openEmbedYoutubeLink(ballId,ballnumber,youtube_link){
    $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option","title","Ball - "+ballnumber+" - Video");
    $("#playVideo")[0].src=convertToEmbedLink(youtube_link);
    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
}

function openVideoHTML(ballId,ballnumber,videoLink,starttime,endtime){

    $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", "Ball - " + ballnumber + " - Video");

    const videoPlayer = document.getElementById('CCVideoPlayer');
    videoPlayer.src = ""; // Clear any previously set video source

    // Handle different types of video links
    if (videoLink.includes("facebook.com")) {
        // Embed Facebook video using iframe, as Facebook doesn't allow direct video links in <video>
        const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
        iframe.src = videoLink.replace('/watch/', '/plugins/video.php?href=https://www.facebook.com/');
        iframe.width = "100%";
        iframe.height = "100%";
        iframe.style.border = "none";
        iframe.allow = "autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; web-share";

        // Replace the video element with the iframe
        const videoContainer = document.getElementById('dialogOpenVideoHTML');
        videoContainer.innerHTML = ""; // Clear previous content
        videoContainer.appendChild(iframe);

    } else if (videoLink.includes("drive.google.com")) {
        // Embed Google Drive video (preview link)
        const fileId = videoLink.match(/[-\w]{25,}/); // Extract file ID
        if (fileId) {
            const embedLink = `https://drive.google.com/file/d//preview`;
            const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
            iframe.src = embedLink;
            iframe.width = "100%";
            iframe.height = "100%";
            iframe.allow = "autoplay";
            iframe.style.border = "none";

            // Replace the video element with the iframe
            const videoContainer = document.getElementById('dialogOpenVideoHTML');
            videoContainer.innerHTML = ""; // Clear previous content
            videoContainer.appendChild(iframe);
        } else {
            // Invalid Google Drive URL
            const videoContainer = document.getElementById('dialogOpenVideoHTML');
            videoContainer.innerHTML = "Invalid Google Drive video link.";
        }

    } else if (videoLink.endsWith(".mp4") || videoLink.endsWith(".webm")) {
        // Direct video link (e.g., mp4, webm)
        videoPlayer.src = videoLink;
        const videoContainer = document.getElementById('dialogOpenVideoHTML');
        videoContainer.innerHTML = ""; // Clear any other content
        videoContainer.appendChild(videoPlayer);

        setTimeout(() => videoPlayer.play(), 1000);

    } else {
        // Unsupported platform or format
        const videoContainer = document.getElementById('dialogOpenVideoHTML');
        videoContainer.innerHTML = "This video format or platform is not supported: " + videoLink;
    }

    // Open the dialog
    $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
}

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },

                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);

                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                        elm = 0; // Reset playlist

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/deleteMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");
                            $('#displyMessage').dialog("open");
                            window.location = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/listMatches.do?clubId=13647';
                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/lockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/unLockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {

                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr("href", "javascript:lockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#unLockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Lock');
                                //$(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    // $("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

    });

    function deleteMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#deleteMessage").html(name);
        $("#deleteId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog("open");
    }

    function lockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#lockMessage").html(name);
        $("#lockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog("open");
    }

    function unLockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#unLockMessage").html(name);
        $("#unLockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog("open");
    }

    function loadView(view) {
        //$('#loading').dialog('open');
        var currentURL = window.location.href;
        var queryString = currentURL.substring(currentURL.indexOf('?'));
        window.location.href = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/' + view + '.do' + queryString;

    }

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function() {
            $('[data-toggle="popover"]').popover();
        });

        //Load Video Data.
        var listOfVideo = [];

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                                }
                            } else {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);
                                const Player = document.getElementById("CCVideoPlayer");
                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                Player.onended = function () {
                                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {
                                        Player.src = nextsrc[elm];
                                        elm++;
                                        Player.play();
                                    } else {
                                        elm = 0; // Reset playlist
                                    }
                                };

                                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
                                setTimeout(() => Player.play(), 500);

                                runningVideo = 0;
                                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo).css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
                            }
                        });
                    } else {
                        videoLinkElement.hide();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        $(window).resize(function () {
            $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "position", "center"); //places the dialog box at the center
            $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog({
                width: $(window).width() > 600 ? $(window).width() - ($(window).width() * 35 / 100) : 'auto',
            });
        });
        let nextsrc = [];
        let runningVideo = 0;
        let ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS;
        let changeClicked = false;

        function pushBallDataToJQS(videoParam, videoSrcIdx) {
            const videoLink = videoParam.ballVideoLink;
            nextsrc.push(videoLink);
            ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS.append(
                "<span class='circle-ball' style='cursor: pointer;' id='ball_idx_" + videoSrcIdx +
                "' onclick='changeTheVideo(" + videoSrcIdx + ")'>" + videoParam.runsDisplay + "</span>");
        }

        function playInHtml5Video(playerId, playerType, playerName) {
            nextsrc = [];
            if (!listOfVideo) {
                return false;
            }
            const videoLink = listOfVideo[0].ballVideoLink;
            if (videoLink.includes('youtube')) {
                ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS = $("#ballCirclesInYoutube");
            } else {
                ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS = $("#ballCirclesInVideoPlayer");
            }
            playerId = parseInt(playerId);
            ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS.empty();
            let videoSrcIdx = 0;

            if (playerType === 'bt') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    const batsmen = listOfVideo[i].batsman;
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'bwl') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].bowler === playerId) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'out') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay === 'W') {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'four') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay == 4) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'six') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].batsman === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay == 6) {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            } else if (playerType === 'blwicket') {
                for (let i = 0; i < listOfVideo.length; i++) {
                    if (listOfVideo[i].bowler === playerId && listOfVideo[i].runsDisplay === 'W') {
                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            let elm = 0;

            let firstBallVideoLink = nextsrc[elm];

            if (firstBallVideoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", playerName + " - Video(s)");
                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                changeClicked = false;
                playYoutubeVideo(elm, false);
            } else {
                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", playerName + " - Video(s)");
                let Player = document.getElementById('CCVideoPlayer');
                Player.onended = function () {
                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {
                        Player.src = nextsrc[elm];
                        elm = elm + 1;
                    }
                }
                Player.onended();
                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
                setTimeout(function () {
                    Player.play();
                }, 500);
                runningVideo = 0;
                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo + "").css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
            }
        }

        function playYoutubeVideo(videoIndex, isChanged) {
            if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                if (videoIndex < nextsrc.length && (isChanged || (!isChanged && !changeClicked))) {
                    const videoLink = nextsrc[videoIndex];
                    const params = videoLink.split('?')[1].split('&')
                    const start = params[0].split('=')[1];
                    const end = params[1].split('=')[1];
                    const elapsed = end - start;
                    $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                    $("#ball_idx_" + videoIndex).css("background-color", "#8b262e");
                    console.log("playing video " + videoIndex + " - " + videoLink + "-" + elapsed);
                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = videoLink.replace("http:", "");
                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        if (isChanged || !changeClicked) {
                            $("#ball_idx_" + videoIndex + "").css("background", "#26578b");
                            playYoutubeVideo(++videoIndex, isChanged);
                        }
                    }, elapsed * 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        let Player = document.getElementById('CCVideoPlayer');
        Player.addEventListener("ended", function (e) {
            // here the end is detected
            console.log("The video has ended");
            runningVideo = runningVideo + 1;
            $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
            $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo + "").css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
        });

        function changeTheVideo(videoIndex) {
            const ballLink = nextsrc[videoIndex];
            if (ballLink.includes("youtube")) {
                changeClicked = true;
                playYoutubeVideo(videoIndex, true)
            } else {
                let Player = document.getElementById('CCVideoPlayer');
                let elm = videoIndex;

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

                    var imgWidth = 210;

                    var doc = new jsPDF('p', 'mm');

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function () {

/////// Mobile Install app Ends
        var linkOfApp = "https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cricclubs&hl=en_US";
        $("#open-app-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Install": function () {
                    window.location = linkOfApp;
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                "Never Ask": function () {
                    localStorage.setItem("dontAskMobileApp", true);
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        function openInApp(appStoreName) {
            $("#shoqAppStoreName").html(appStoreName);
            $("#open-app-confirm").dialog("open");
        }

        function checkAndOpenForMobileUser() {
            var userAgent = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;

            if (userAgent.match(/iPad/i) || userAgent.match(/iPhone/i) || userAgent.match(/iPod/i)) {
                linkOfApp = "https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cricclubs/id978682715"
                openInApp('App Store');

            } else if (userAgent.match(/Android/i)) {
                linkOfApp = 'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cricclubs&hl=en_US;';
                openInApp('Play Store');
            }
        }

        
/////// Mobile Install app Ends

        $("#dialog-confirm-TnC").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            width: '80%'
        });


        var isMobile = {
            Android: function () {
                return navigator.userAgent.match(/Android/i);
            },
            BlackBerry: function () {
                return navigator.userAgent.match(/BlackBerry/i);
            },
            iOS: function () {
                return navigator.userAgent.match(/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i);
            },
            Opera: function () {
                return navigator.userAgent.match(/Opera Mini/i);
            },
            Windows: function () {
                return navigator.userAgent.match(/IEMobile/i);
            },
            any: function () {
                return (isMobile.Android() || isMobile.BlackBerry() || isMobile.iOS() || isMobile.Opera() || isMobile.Windows());
            }
        };
        $(".calendarBox").datepicker();

        

        $(document).on("click", '.whatsapp', function () {
            if (isMobile.any()) {
                var text = document.title;
                var url = window.location.href;
                var message = encodeURIComponent(text) + " - " + encodeURIComponent(url);
                var whatsapp_url = "whatsapp://send?text=" + message;
                window.location.href = whatsapp_url;
            } else {
                alert("Please share this article in mobile device");
            }
        });
        
    });

    function showTerms() {
        $("#dialog-confirm-TnC").dialog("open");
    }

    function mobileFacebookShare() {
        window.open('https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=' + window.location.href, 'facebookWindow', 'width=600, height=300, left=64, top=44, scrollbars, resizable');
    }

    function mobileTwitterShare() {
        window.open('https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=' + window.location.href + '&text=' + document.title, 'twitterWindow', 'width=600, height=300, left=64, top=44, scrollbars, resizable');
    }

    function mobileGoogleShare() {
        window.open('https://plus.google.com/share?url=' + window.location.href, 'googleWindow', 'width=600, height=300, left=64, top=44, scrollbars, resizable');
    }

    function mobileMailShare() {
        window.location.href = 'mailto:?Subject=' + document.title + '&Body=' + window.location.href;
    }

    var addthis_share = {
        url: window.location.href,
        title: document.title
    }

    function getURLOfPage() {
        return window.location.href;
    }

    function getTitleofPage() {
        return document.title;
    }

    function resizeScroll() {
        $('html').getNiceScroll().remove();
        var nice = $("html").niceScroll({
            zindex: 1000000,
            cursorborder: "",
            cursorborderradius: "2px",
            cursorwidth: "14px",
            cursorcolor: "#191919",
            cursoropacitymin: .5
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        


    });


</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/deleteMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");
                            $('#displyMessage').dialog("open");
                            window.location = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/listMatches.do?clubId=13647';
                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/lockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/unLockMatch.do?clubId=13647&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {

                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr("href", "javascript:lockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#unLockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Lock');
                                //$(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    // $("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

    });

    function deleteMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#deleteMessage").html(name);
        $("#deleteId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog("open");
    }

    function lockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#lockMessage").html(name);
        $("#lockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog("open");
    }

    function unLockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#unLockMessage").html(name);
        $("#unLockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog("open");
    }

    function loadView(view) {
        //$('#loading').dialog('open');
        var currentURL = window.location.href;
        var queryString = currentURL.substring(currentURL.indexOf('?'));
        window.location.href = '/HoustonUnitedPremierLeague/' + view + '.do' + queryString;

    }

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                                }
                            } else {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);
                                const Player = document.getElementById("CCVideoPlayer");
                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                Player.onended = function () {
                                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {
                                        Player.src = nextsrc[elm];
                                        elm++;
                                        Player.play();
                                    } else {
                                        elm = 0; // Reset playlist
                                    }
                                };

                                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
                                setTimeout(() => Player.play(), 500);

                                runningVideo = 0;
                                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo).css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
                            }
                        });
                    } else {
                        videoLinkElement.hide();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        $(window).resize(function () {
